name: Tempered Palm
description: Strike with a palm hardened by long drill so the blow lands as a flat wall of force.

name: Force Guard
description: Meet a blow with a braced arm and let qi in the muscle spread the shock through the body.

name: Driving Pace
description: Press the ground away with the rear foot to cross a short gap with the shoulders square.

name: Muscle Rouse
description: Wake the large muscles with a slow breath of qi so the next several movements carry more force.

name: Frame Lock
description: Pin the target's torso against the user's own with both arms and lock the frame so it cannot twist.

name: Burden Reckoning
description: Feel how much weight the user can still bear and how much strength the legs have left.

name: Driving Palm
description: Step through and drive the palm with the whole body behind it so the blow carries the target backward.

name: Crush Rhythm
description: Land a measured run of heavy blows that each break a little more of the target's guard.

name: Crush Hold
description: Close both hands on the target's forearm and squeeze with qi until the limb goes slack.

name: Knee Drive
description: Pull the target down by the shoulders and drive the knee up into the body.

name: Low Guard
description: Crouch behind locked arms and let qi in the shoulders carry the weight of a heavy strike.

name: Strength Draw
description: Draw qi from the core into the hands so that every grip tightens with more force.

name: Arm Lock
description: Fold the target's arm against its own joint and hold it there with the body's weight.

name: Breaking Clasp
description: Clasp a limb and wrench until the joint gives and the target loses the use of that arm.

name: Pinning Weight
description: Drop the whole weight of the body onto a held target and keep it pinned against all struggle.

name: Pack Lift
description: Fill the back and thighs with qi so a heavy pack or a body rises with little effort.

name: Yoke Stance
description: Stand with the weight across both shoulders and let the load itself blunt a hard blow.

name: Burden Stride
description: Keep a quick even pace under a heavy load by driving each step through the heel.

name: Spine Brace
description: Stiffen the spine with qi so a crushing weight or a hard fall does not bend it.

name: Load Shift
description: Throw the carried weight to the other shoulder in one move to turn a rush aside.

name: Carry Surge
description: Heave a wounded ally onto the back and move off with a sudden burst of leg strength.

name: Laden Strike
description: Swing the carried load into the target as the body turns so the weight itself becomes the blow.

name: Laden Guard
description: Hold the burden before the chest with qi in the arms so it turns heavy blows and holds firm.

name: Endurance Haul
description: Spread qi through the legs and lungs so a load can be hauled a long way without the body failing.

name: Wring Grip
description: Twist a seized limb the way a cloth is wrung to wear down the target's hold and strength.

name: Rend Pull
description: Rip a seized sleeve or arm sharply sideways to tear the target out of its stance.

name: Rip Strike
description: Hook the fingers into the target and tear the hand outward across the body.

name: Rend Sense
description: Feel along a held limb or garment for the place where it will tear first.

name: Sundering Pull
description: Wrench a gripped guard apart with both arms so the target is thrown open for the next blow.

name: Rending Surge
description: Pour qi into the forearms so that every pull and wrench tears with greater force.

name: Heavy Hook
description: Swing the heavy hand in a wide arc into the side of the target's guard.

name: Mallet Palm
description: Bring the heel of the hand down onto the target's shoulder like a mallet on a stake.

name: Slam Guard
description: Slam both forearms together before the chest and hold the line against a heavy attack.

name: Press Advance
description: Press forward with heavy hands up and step by step crowd the target out of its space.

name: Fist Rhythm
description: Fall into a slow beat of breath and fist so qi gathers in the hands with every cycle.

name: Hand Surge
description: Send a quick surge of qi down the arm to make a single strike or grip far stronger.

name: Blow Sense
description: Read from the shock in the wrist how much damage a landed blow did to the target.

name: Falling Fist
description: Raise the fist high and let the whole body fall with it onto the target in one crushing drop.

name: Crushing Hand
description: Drive the hand through the target's guard with qi at the fingertips and close it on what lies beyond.

name: Fatigue Purge
description: Drive qi through strained muscle to clear the numbing ache and weakness of overwork from the user or an ally.

name: Driving Shoulder
description: Lower the near shoulder and drive it into the target's chest as the legs push.

name: Elbow Ram
description: Ram the point of the elbow into the target's ribs as the body turns past.

name: Charge Guard
description: Hold the shoulder forward as a wedge so an incoming rush strikes the user's thickest muscle.

name: Plunge Step
description: Drop the weight and plunge forward from the back foot to land beside the target.

name: Back Surge
description: Send qi up the spine into the shoulders so the next rush carries the whole back behind it.

name: Charge Sense
description: Feel the ground through the feet to know how a rushing body is shifting its weight.

name: Shoulder Ram
description: Charge with the shoulder low and the legs driving so the target is thrown back and pinned.

name: Ramming Rush
description: Rush the length of a room in three strides and strike the target with the full frame at the end.

name: Torso Guard
description: Stiffen the whole body as one block so a heavy attack finds no give to exploit.

name: Spine Press
description: Press the palm into the target's spine and push with the whole upright frame behind it.

name: Unyielding Rise
description: Rise from a knee or a fall in one movement with the legs driving the whole body up.

name: Bone Heft
description: Hold the stance and let qi rise through the bones until the whole frame feels heavier and firmer.

name: Sinew Sense
description: Feel through the stance whether the user's own frame has a weak joint that a blow could break.

name: Unbending Brawn
description: Lock the frame against a heavy blow with qi in every joint so that the user is not moved.

name: Immovable Stand
description: Hold the stand under a rush and release the stored shock back through the palm in one strike.

name: Double Palm
description: Strike with both palms at once on either side of the target so the force meets inside the body.

name: Double Grip
description: Seize with both hands on one limb and close them in opposite twists.

name: Double Shove
description: Shove with both hands to drive the target back a full pace and break its stance.

name: Double Guard
description: Cross both forearms before the chest and share the shock of a blow between them.

name: Double Surge
description: Send qi into both hands at once so each hand carries equal strength in strike and grip.

name: Double Sense
description: Feel with both hands at once how much force a target can bring to bear on each side.

name: Double Crush
description: Bring both fists together on the target's guard from above and below to crush it between them.

name: Double Heave
description: Seize with both hands and heave the target over the shoulder so its feet leave the ground.

name: Double Hold
description: Pin the target between both hands and arms and keep the hold steady against its full struggle.
